  • Method Details

    • getDaoName

      public static @Nullable com.squareup.javapoet.ClassName getDaoName(AbstractConfigStructure ast, ConfigurationClassNameGenerator classNameGenerator)
      Resolves the DAO name for a configuration structure. For interfaces, this is the generated DefaultMethodAccess class. For classes, this is the original class itself.
      Parameters:
      ast - The configuration structure
      classNameGenerator - The class name generator
      Returns:
      The DAO class name, or null if it's an interface without any defaults

    • addDaoInstantiationIfNecessary

      public static void addDaoInstantiationIfNecessary(AbstractConfigStructure ast, com.squareup.javapoet.MethodSpec.Builder methodBuilder, @Nullable com.squareup.javapoet.ClassName daoName)
      Adds a DAO instantiation statement to a method builder if the configuration has any default values.
      Parameters:
      ast - The configuration structure
      methodBuilder - The method builder to add the statement to
      daoName - The DAO class name

    • getPropertyAccess

      public static com.squareup.javapoet.CodeBlock getPropertyAccess(AbstractConfigStructure ast, Property property, String variableName, MethodNames methodNames, boolean useGetters)
      Generates a CodeBlock for accessing a property on a given variable.
      Parameters:
      ast - The configuration structure
      property - The property to access
      variableName - The name of the variable to access the property on
      methodNames - The method names generator (used for safe method names in classes)
      useGetters - Whether to use getter methods (true) or direct field access (false) for classes
      Returns:
      A CodeBlock representing the property access
